### Dependency security check: escalated

`lodash 4.17.15 → 4.17.21`: escalated, three advisories still present on the target; minimum safe version 4.18.0

| Advisory | Severity | Summary | Affected → fixed | vs current | Codebase use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc) | high | Code injection via `_.template` | `<4.18.0` → 4.18.0 | still present | not found |
| [GHSA-f23m-r3pf-42rh](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-f23m-r3pf-42rh) | moderate | Prototype pollution | `<4.18.0` → 4.18.0 | still present | `src/payload.ts:6` |
| [GHSA-xxjr-mmjv-4gpg](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xxjr-mmjv-4gpg) | moderate | Prototype pollution | `<4.18.0` → 4.18.0 | still present | `src/payload.ts:6` |

- **Low severity**: none
- **Not checked**: none
- **Decision**: accepted risk, by @maintainer, 2026-10-25, `_.unset` only sees server-built keys.

Sources: OSV.dev, GitHub Advisory Database, deps.dev; queried 2026-10-25T14:08:52Z.
